evidence.claim: The two hip origins are bilateral and lie in the proximal thigh surface; their current parent is the anterior axial Bone_002 rather than the measured pelvis Bone_001.
The welded surface is connected; lower-jaw ownership is instead supported by the existing Bone_044 to Bone_043 to Bone_042 hierarchy and its concentrated lower-head weights.

evidence.reference: White et al. 2013, PLOS ONE 8:e68649, Table 2, Allosaurus fragilis UUVP 6000r
evidence.claim: Femur, tibia and metatarsus lengths 880, 730 and 375 mm give 44.33%, 36.77% and 18.90% of their sum; used only as a specimen-specific segment-proportion sanity check along the source chain.

limitations: The artist model is not established as UUVP 6000r and the published lengths do not determine exact surface landmarks.
The jaw hinge is an inferred engineering landmark supported by existing hierarchy and weights, not a fossil-derived joint center.
Hand and pedal digit anatomy remains unresolved; no independent digit pivots are invented.
The candidate is not admitted to a baseline, motion catalog, Unity project or production asset set.
